title: Kuroko prompts.toml
description: Prompts for Kuroko (%APPDATA%\Kuroko\prompts.toml). One [[prompt]] block per prompt. Mirrors src/Kuroko.Core/Config/PromptsLoader.cs; the app itself reports errors with file and line.

name.description: Name shown in the overlay. Must be unique (not case-sensitive).

prompt.description: The instruction sent to the AI. Must not be empty.

mode.description: transform: edits the selected text, or the whole field. instruction: treats the text in the field as the task. universal: no marker: the text is the task; with a marker: applies it to the rest of the text.

output.description: Where the result goes, independent of mode. replace: the result replaces the selected text (or the whole field). overlay: the result is shown in a small card and the text stays as it is; works on read-only text such as web pages.

provider.description: Name of a [providers.<name>] block in settings.toml. Empty or missing: default_provider.

model.description: Overrides the provider's model for this prompt.

hotkey.description: Runs the prompt directly, without the overlay. Modifiers Ctrl (Control, Strg), Alt, Shift (Umschalt), Win (Windows) joined with + and a key: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F24, Space, Enter, Tab, Esc, Backspace, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Left, Up, Right, Down or one of ; = , - . / ` [ \ ] '. At least one modifier unless the key is F1-F24. Empty: no hotkey.
